population: Freeze before collecting any new crossed activity/relation readers. Original temporal-prefix cohort: all 12 training windows (91 unique questions); report previously excluded windows. Inspect the three already confirmed direct decisions first, then measure every question from all matched windows. Hold fixed the prefix, source, ordered input retrieval, first two slots, original BF16 writer instructions, raw response and token cap. Use no validation or test question.
interventions: Cross the deployed activity and relationship writer templates with dated_adjacent_turns and dated_single_turns. The grouping rule is applied after greedy generation. For each template verify byte-identical writer prompt and matching archived response, reparse through the real Executor with each rule, reconstruct the whole bank, verify the two original banks and each original ordered reader context. Require both original answers, F1 and token counts to repeat on the target reader. Exact authenticated same-backend requests may reuse their original response. Any mismatch is explicit. These are diagnostic interventions; the deployed choices remain the three original versions.
components: Use the two-order Shapley decomposition (Lundberg & Lee, NeurIPS 2017, https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2017/hash/8a20a8621978632d76c43dfd28b67767-Abstract.html). For each question from A/pairs to R/single, average each factor's marginal effect in the two orders, record both conditional effects and the interaction. Components sum to the measured F1 contrast. Only a previously confirmed rule-2 physical label receives choice credit; distribute its signed magnitude in proportion to sign-aligned component effects. Opposite-sign effects remain visible as measurements. A failed crossed measurement supplies zero component-specific credit.
policy: On the 10 authenticated time-prefix windows/74 questions, exclude the entire target history. Fit total raw R-A F1 to additive writer and grouping heads with parent features [1,source affinity/2] and [1,standardized crowding], equal-history weights, ridge .04 on the two intercepts, .25 on slopes. Verified component targets are summed by window and divided by all original questions. Add squared-hinge constraints on the responsible heads at the parent's credit weights. Compare to identical raw, equal split, swapped heads, within-history rotated paired labels, undivided evidence on the full score, previous credit, native and conditional rate controls. Keep parent's temporal probability fixed. Fit once after all originally confirmed direct labels have been examined. Separately, after all windows finish, learn both raw component heads on physically measured per-window Shapley means (same whole-window inclusion and raw-only baseline). Never fit new choice credit from unconfirmed questions. Freeze both cohorts of later 25 decisions (209 questions) and 12 earlier original states (123 questions) with exposure. Retain existing training and representative independent test gates.
